scripts.build:theme: npm run gen:theme && npm run build -w @veneer/theme
scripts.build:cli: npm run gen:registry && npm run build -w veneer
scripts.build: npm run build:theme && npm run build -w playground && npm run build:cli
scripts.dev: npm run build:theme && npm run dev -w playground
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:theme && npm run gen:registry && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:theme && npm run gen:registry && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
